description: Client-side script for managing data tables, modals, and API interactions in an admin panel of a transportation management system.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches data from API and populates the table with results, handling pagination.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Extracts headers (keys) from result objects for table display.

methods.name: makeTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML table and modals for displaying and editing data records.

methods.name: makeModals
methods.description: Creates modals for updating, creating, and deleting records.

methods.name: updateRecord
methods.description: Sends PUT request to update a record in the API.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Sends DELETE request to remove a record from the API.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Sends POST request to create a new record in the API.

methods.name: getRowId
methods.description: Retrieves the record ID from a modal input.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Handles password change via API call.
